summary.text: Terry Hatton is the Republican candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 67 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Matthew Lehman.
He ran for the same seat in 2024, losing to Lehman 50.1% to 49.9%, a margin of 30 votes.

paragraphs.text: Terry Hatton won the May 21, 2024 Republican primary for Kentucky House District 67, defeating Brian Ormes, 81.7% to 18.3%.
In the 2024 general election he received 9,405 votes to Lehman's 9,435.
He advanced from the 2026 Republican primary without appearing on the ballot, because the primary was canceled.
